mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.3% compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals economic distress, triggering policy responses that produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY inflation > 3.0%) triggers aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: High employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, yielding positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline.
